notes.title: Update 1.3.0 NEXT
notes.notes:
Thank you all for the help and support in purchasing and reviewing this game!

We started the year with our first big update, which included migrating to a new engine version and some other QOL improvements. Continuing with improvements, I wanted to focus more on the PC side!

This game was originally designed to run on portable gaming hardware such as the Steam Deck, which could automatically handle screen size and volume controls. When on PC, I never accounted for saving custom settings such as volume, Fullscreen mode, or aspect ratio. It just slipped my mind!

With the new menu System, I can handle all those settings being saved separately, no matter the device or platform you play on! Along with this new menu system, it gives room for new things, such as more options and game customization!

Some of the new features are already being added!

New Game Modes


 Classic Mode - No Boss Included.
 Boss Mode - Extended Story With Boss Room.
 Cozy Mode - No story, No Boss, No Timers, No Nonsense! Just Frogs! 


All these modes will save, so you can always pick up where you left off! 

Enjoy the game how you want to play, and stay tuned for future updates!

Happy Next Fest!

notes.title: Update 2024
notes.notes:
This update brings some better QOL improvements to those who want a bit more laid-back adventure while being able to finish at the same time!

Game modes

 Classic - Classic Adventure mode with storytelling and an easy, less challenging ending!
 Boss Mode - Adventure mode with a twist at the end! Can you defeat the King?


In the future, new things will be added to each mode type! The Boss Mode will never allow any progression saving. If you leave during a Boss Mode run, Your progress will be saved, but the boss will get bored and leave... Your opportunity to meet the king will only continue with a fresh and continuous adventure!

That means if you decide to leave a boss mode run, it will convert to a standard run after leaving. This will allow you to continue your story wherever you left off!

Time Attack 

 Updated mode for better handling more frogs and more adventures in the future! 


The adventures will continue, Stay tuned for more updates!

Happy New Year!

notes.title: Game load Bug Fix!
notes.notes:
Fixes potential bug from the game being able to load properly and crashing. 

If your game doesn't load, make sure you are on the latest build of the game by uninstalling and forcing steam to re-install. The game should open, and you should be on update .05!

Hopefully, this bug does not effect anyone, but there is a small possibility!
